about_the_game:
Step into the forgotten ruins of Frilensgrade, a kingdom now engulfed in shadows and mystery

Bound by fate, two players must navigate in this kingdom to solve ancient mechanisms and face a cursed legacy - together.

  • 🔍 Asymmetrical puzzle-solving: each player sees the world differently. Communication is your only lifeline.

  • 🧩 Challenging cooperative gameplay: explore, decode, and survive through twisted logic and eerie environments.

  • 🕯️ Atmospheric dark fantasy: a minimalistic low-poly art style enhances a world of dread, wonder, and forgotten lore.

  • 🎮 Designed for 2-player online co-op via Steam. Trust is everything — betrayal is losing.

Will you make it... or not?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 280
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible / built-in
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Online co-op requires a stable internet connection. Controller support available
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible / built-in
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Online co-op requires a stable internet connection. Controller support available

short_description: A dark fantasy co-op puzzle game. Explore the abandoned kingdom of Frilensgrade with a partner, solve asymmetric puzzles, and uncover the forgotten secrets of this kingdom. Only together you can do it.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Simplified Chinese, Japanese
*languages with full audio support
